item.description:
Dan & the Danette's talk about Panthers QB Bryce Young's impressive career rebound and why young QB's should get more time, MLB analyst John Smoltz joins the show to talk about the MLB playoffs and modern day pitching, a look at USC - Penn State, and more!

item.description:
Dan Patrick & the Danette's talk about the Dallas Cowboys "embarrassing" loss to the Tampa Bay Buccaneers on Thursday Night Football, remembering listener & caller Chris in Syracuse following news of his passing, calls pour in about Chris in Syracuse, and more.

item.title: Hour 3 – Hot Seats Getting Hotter
item.description:
Dan & the Danette’s talk about Rams WR Puka Nacua being a 5th round pick and question how so many scouting departments could have missed on him, coaches that find themselves on the hot seat at this point in the NFL season and who could be fired first, quick thoughts on tonight’s Monday Night Football game between the Bills and Rams, listener calls, and more!

item.title: Hour 2 – Time Management
item.description:
Dan & the Danette’s discuss the Washington Commanders time management blunder at the end of overtime that led to their tie with the New York Giants, best and worst of the weekend, listeners call in, and more!

item.title: Hour 1 – Excited For Nothing, Chase Daniel
item.description:
Dan Patrick talks about the Brewers Game 1 win over the Dodgers, the Jaguars taking down the Eagles in London and the decisions that led to the loss, the Giants and Commanders end in a tie and the Giants were really excited about it, what happens with the LA Chargers after they fall to 0-5, Chase Daniel joins the show to break down Week 5 in the NFL, and more!

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 – Sean Casey, Overshadowed Tuesday
item.description:
Former MLB 1B and current analyst, Sean Casey stops by to break down the Dodgers’ struggles as well as the ALCS. Plus, DP and the Danettes consider which NFL players are being overshadowed despite impressive performances.

item.title: Hour 2 – Scott Van Pelt, Ross Tucker
item.description:
Scott Van Pelt drops by after a long night covering the Rams/Bills thriller in Los Angeles. And NFL insider Ross Tucker joins the show to break down an eventful Week 5 of the NFL season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 1 – Rams/Bills Thriller, Arch Manning Should Stay in School
item.description:
Dan wonders if the Rams will be able to turn around their season after a rough start. And he reacts to the Dodgers struggling against the Brewers and rumors that Shohei Ohtani may be riding the pine in Game 3 tomorrow.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – ALCS Is the “Other” Series, Al Michaels
item.description:
With all the focus on the Dodgers and Brewers in the NLCS, DP talks about the “other” series for the American League. And broadcasting legend Al Michaels stops by to and pays his respects to Mike Ditka, and tells DP he’ll know when it’s time to hang it up.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Rory McIlroy Reacts to the Collapse of the LIV Golf Tour, Joey Votto
item.description:
Rory McIlroy chimed in on why the LIV Golf Tour failed, and DP thinks his comments are spot on. Plus, former MLB player and current analyst, Joey Votto drops by to weigh in on the struggles of Shohei Ohtani and the rest of the MLB Playoffs.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Shohei Ohtani Will Play, Micah Parsons Criticizes Jayden Daniels
item.description:
Dodgers’ Manager Dave Roberts confirmed that Shohei Ohtani will be in the starting lineup tonight for Game 3 of the NLCS and DP considers the options for the struggling superstar. And Packers LB Micah Parsons held nothing back as he criticized Commanders QB Jayden Daniels for his clock mismanagement at the end of overtime on Sunday.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Tom Verducci, Mark Schlereth
item.description:
Fox Sports baseball analyst Tom Verducci joins Dan to discuss the hole the Dodgers find themselves in down 0-3 to the Brewers in the NLCS as well as the impending labor dispute that will soon engulf Major League Baseball. And Former NFL offensive lineman and NFL analyst Mark Schlereth joins the show to talk about the struggles of the Denver Broncos and their quarterback Bo Nix, the debacle ending of Commanders-Giants and why he thinks Joe Burrow is the best quarterback in football.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Brady Quinn, Signature Moves
item.description:
Big Noon Kickoff and 2 Pros and a Cup of Joe host, Brady Quinn joins Dan to talk about the upcoming marquee showdown between Indiana and Ohio State, and how the masses still haven’t really caught onto the idea of Indiana being a dominant juggernaut. The Danettes and callers weigh in on players with iconic moves, and Odell Beckham Jr’s famous one-handed catch.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – Dodgers Must-Win, TNF Preview
item.description:
Dan reacts to the Los Angeles Dodgers falling to 0-3 in the NLDS against the Milwaukee Brewers. Can they somehow find a way to stay alive? The Danettes compare the situation to the last reverse sweep and talk about memories of the 2004 Red Sox. And DP weighs in on the Broncos as they get ready to face the Seahawks tonight.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: The Cutoff Episode 5: Home Brewed
item.description:
Dan G and Mario break down the Brewers 3-0 lead over the Dodgers in the NLCS before recapping the Guardians game 3 win to take a 2-1 series lead over the Rays in the ALCS

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 – Breakup in the Booth, Jon Morosi
item.description:
The long-standing pair of Joe Buck and Troy Aikman calling NFL games might be finally getting the axe as Buck gets a contract extension, but Troy Aikman is done after this year. MLB insider Jon Morosi joins Dan to discuss the fallout of the sudden end of the Dodgers playoff run, what is going to happen to their dynasty, what options lay in front of Shohei Ohtani in dealing with his injuries plus discusses the different style of offenses that come up in the baseball postseason.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Is the Dodgers Dynasty Dead?, Heather Dinich
item.description:
Dan wonders if the Dodgers are a dynasty beginning to age out as baseball becomes younger and the Dodgers lineup gets older. College football insider Heather Dinich joins Dan to discuss the College Football Playoff expanding to 24 teams, the implications of that expansion on the landscape of the sport, and who benefits and who doesn’t.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 1 – TNF Recap, Brewers Advance to the World Series, Domonique Foxworth
item.description:
Thursday Night Football saw a victory for Denver, but Todd Fritz isn’t wearing his Broncos gear. The Dodgers got swept and the fallout is already hitting baseball. Former NFL CB Domonique Foxworth joins Dan to break down Broncos and Seahawks game, the Chargers not living up to the hype, and the best quarterbacks he’s watching right now in the NFL.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 3 – Getting the Calls Right, Caleb Willams Return
item.description:
DP talks about some of the terrible calls by referees in the NFL and college football recently and how difficult it is for these officials to get it right. And he weighs in on Bears QB Caleb Williams successful return to action yesterday.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
item.itunes:author: Dan Patrick

item.title: Hour 2 – Colts Pursuing Peyton Manning, Rick Neuheisel
item.description:
Dan addresses reports that the Indianapolis Colts are pursuing Peyton Manning to take over as their General Manager. And Rick Neuheisel drops by to weigh in on the crazy weekend of college football and the upcoming expansion of the College Football Playoff to 24 teams.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 1 – NFL Week 6 Recap, CFP Expansion Will Make it Better
item.description:
Dan recaps another eventful week in the NFL, and an even more exciting week of college football. He is convinced expanding the College Football Playoff to 24 teams wouldn’t have lessened the entertainment value of the upsets we saw yesterday and that it will ultimately be a good thing for the sport.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 – Overshadowed Tuesday, Grant Hill
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss the great performances from Week 6 of the NFL season that may have gone overlooked. Plus, Grant Hill drops by to talk a little hoops as the NBA season tips off tonight.

item.title: Hour 2 – Cookout Etiquette, Louis Riddick
item.description:
Dan and the Danettes discuss whether it's acceptable to eat a hotdog without a traditional hotdog bun. And NFL insider Louis Riddick joined the show to give his insight into Hurts' situation as well as why he's high on CJ Stroud.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 1 – Eagles Mishandling Jalen Hurts’ Bood Clots, NBA Begins
item.description:
Dan wonders why the Philadelphia Eagles haven’t had someone from their medical team address the media about Jalen Hurts’ blood clots. And the NAB tips off tonight and DP gets ready to talk some hoops.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 – CFP Drama, NFL Best and Worst Offseason Moves
item.description:
Dan reacts to reports that Ohio State may be without QB Julian Sayin for the rest of the season. And he gives his best and worst NFL offseason moves now that we are officially 1/3 of the way through the season.

item.title: Hour 2 – NFLPA Demands Investigation for Jalen Hurts, Booger McFarland
item.description:
The NFL Players Association is demanding a thorough investigation into the medical treatment of Jalen Hurts and his blood clots after the NFL said everything was fine. NFL insider Booger McFarland drops by to weigh in on Jalen Hurts’ situation and the rest of the story lines entering Week 7 of the NFL season.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 1 – No Dynasty for the Knicks, Pat Murphy
item.description:
DP weighs in on the opening night in the NBA where the defending champion New York Knicks lost to LeBron James and the 76ers and aren’t even favored to win the Eastern Conference. Plus, Milwaukee Brewers manager Pat Murphy joins the show as he gets his squad ready to face the Rays in the World Series.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 3 – The Dominican LeBron, Mike Florio
item.description:
DP and the Danettes discuss Yaxel Lendeborg’s future in the NBA and his relatively unknown nickname: The Dominican LeBron. Dan interviews Pro Football Talk writer Mike Florio about the Giants’ decision to start J.J. McCarthy over Jameis Winston. They also discuss the NFL fining head coaches for interactions with officials, buyers and sellers at the trade deadline, and Josh Jacobs removal from the Commissioner’s Exempt List.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 2 – Nobody Fears LeBron, Albert Breer
item.description:
Dan and the guys discuss why no one fears LeBron the way they did Larry Bird or Michael Jordan. And MMQB Senior Reporter Albert Breer stops by with an update on their game in Paris on Sunday between the Steelers and Saints considering the protests occurring in France.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.title: Hour 1 – Yaxel vs. Luka, Booth Changes, Tom Waddle
item.description:
Yaxel Lendeborg and Luka Dončić had an epic battle last night and DP is here for it. DP and the Danettes consider Tony Romo’s broadcasting future and wonder if he could be Troy Aikman’s replacement for Monday Night Football considering the tension in the booth between him and Joe Buck. And former Chicago Bears receiver Tom Waddle drops by and weighs in on Caleb Williams, whether the Bears fear the Vikings, and tells some personal stories of Mike Ditka.

See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.

item.description:
On this episode of The Cutoff, Dan G and Mario preview the World Series matchup between the Milwaukee Brewers and the Tampa Bay Rays, outlining their x-factors for the series as well as making their World Series predictions. Enjoy!
